priority_basis: source/PIT feasibility and implementation novelty only; never performance
purpose: Deep literature-derived orthogonal candidate development from administrative convergence, pharmaceutical substitution networks, environmental enforcement escalation and patent citation provenance.

candidates.name: ADMINISTRATIVE_INFORMATION_CONVERGENCE × ISSUER_EXPOSURE
candidates.hypothesis: Independent public administrative channels may jointly identify externally observable operating stress with less idiosyncratic noise than any single event source.
candidates.construction: Construct a binary/state convergence record only from individually PIT-valid source prefixes across Q187-Q192. A source contributes only after its own historical public-observation boundary, entity mapping and revision lineage are proven. The convergence relation is fixed as a count/state of independent source families affecting the same frozen issuer or operating footprint; no return data, weights, thresholds, event windows or post-hoc source selection may enter construction.
candidates.next_gate: individual source PIT validation; fixed issuer/facility/product mappings; only then composition compiler and independent reproduction

candidates.name: THERAPEUTIC_SUBSTITUTION_PRESSURE × SHORTAGE_STATE
candidates.hypothesis: A public shortage affecting one manufacturer/product can create deterministic substitution pressure toward alternative products/manufacturers sharing the same active ingredient or therapeutically equivalent product group.
candidates.construction: Use fixed FDA shortage state plus FDA Orange Book product/applicant/application/product/ingredient/therapeutic-equivalence fields. Build a manufacturer-to-product-to-equivalence graph from the frozen monthly Orange Book snapshot and apply only historical shortage states publicly observable by the proven boundary. Exposure is a fixed relation between the shortage node and alternative issuer nodes; no graph-depth, threshold, market-share or return-derived edge weighting search is permitted.
candidates.next_gate: historical shortage archive/public-clock proof; monthly Orange Book vintage reconstruction; product/applicant-to-issuer mapping; revision/discontinuation lineage; independent reproduction

candidates.name: EPA_INSPECTION_TO_ENFORCEMENT_ESCALATION × FACILITY_EXPOSURE
candidates.hypothesis: The transition from inspection/compliance finding to formal enforcement provides a distinct regulatory-pressure state beyond a static enforcement-event indicator.
candidates.construction: Join frozen facility-level ECHO evaluation/violation/enforcement records using documented keys and preserve each record's source date separately from ECHO extraction/refresh date. The state machine is NO_INSPECTION → INSPECTED_NO_VIOLATION → VIOLATION_OBSERVED → ENFORCEMENT_ACTION. A decision prefix may use only what the public ECHO vintage exposed; later refreshes cannot backfill earlier states.
candidates.next_gate: historical ECHO vintage census; facility identity and issuer mapping; record lineage/revision semantics; independent reproduction

candidates.name: PATENT_CITATION_PROVENANCE_MIX × TECHNOLOGY_EXPOSURE
candidates.hypothesis: The provenance mix of prior-art citations (applicant/inventor versus examiner-added) can encode a distinct information-generation process and may separate predictable from externally discovered technological knowledge.
candidates.construction: Use patent grant/publication documents and a frozen technology-exposure map. Preserve citation provenance when available and construct a fixed provenance-mix state for each issuing technology owner. Exclude self-citations and any citation whose public-observation boundary is not independently proven. This is a provenance-state hypothesis, not a Q186 citation-count or network-shock variant.
candidates.next_gate: historical provenance-field completeness; document retrieval census; public-observation clock; assignee-to-issuer mapping; independent reproduction

cross_channel_designs: Q193 may later compose Q194/Q195 only after their individual PIT gates; no joint ranking is allowed before that.
Q194 is intentionally separated from Q192 by adding a fixed alternative-product/manufacturer substitution graph.
Q195 is a transition-state expansion of environmental information timing, not a second generic enforcement-event counter.
Q196 is a provenance-state test distinct from Q186's upstream grant shock/citation topology.
literature_basis: Patent citations: Belenzon (2012), Hall/Jaffe/Trajtenberg (2005), Hirshleifer/Hsu/Li (2013), Kogan/Papanikolaou/Seru/Stoffman (2017), Hsu/Lee/Zhou (2022).
Drug shortages/supply networks: Tucker/Daskin (2021), Eberhardt et al. (2025), Nguyen et al. (2021), Shukar et al. (2021).
Government procurement: Canayaz (2017), Dong et al. (2024), Samuels (2020).
